subject: ❌ Accommodation Application Decision - Reference #$accommodation_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Thank you for your accommodation application to the University Housing Department. After careful review, we regret to inform you that your application has NOT been approved at this time.

=== APPLICATION DETAILS ===
Reference Number: $accommodation_id
Accommodation Type: $accommodation_type
Review Date: $review_date
Reviewed By: $reviewed_by
Requested Start Date: $start_date
Requested End Date: $end_date

=== REASON FOR REJECTION ===
$rejection_reason

=== EXPLANATION ===
$detailed_explanation

=== YOUR OPTIONS ===

1. APPEAL THE DECISION
   If you believe this decision was made in error or if you have additional information that was not considered, you may appeal this decision.
   
   Appeal Process:
   - Submit your appeal within 10 business days
   - Include any additional supporting documentation
   - Clearly state why you believe the decision should be reconsidered
   - Email appeals to: housing.appeals@university.edu
   - Subject line: "Appeal - Application #$accommodation_id"
   
   Appeal Timeline:
   - Appeals are reviewed within 5-7 business days
   - You will receive a final decision via email
   - The appeal decision is final

2. SUBMIT A NEW APPLICATION
   You may submit a new application if:
   - You have addressed the reasons for rejection
   - Your circumstances have changed
   - Additional documentation is now available
   - You are applying for a different accommodation type
   
   To submit a new application:
   - Log into the Housing Portal
   - Start a new application
   - Ensure all required documentation is included
   - Reference this rejection (Application #$accommodation_id)

3. EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE OPTIONS
   - Off-Campus Housing Resources: housing.offcampus@university.edu
   - Temporary Housing: housing.temp@university.edu
   - Housing Assistance Program: housing.assistance@university.edu
   - Roommate Matching Service: housing.roommates@university.edu

=== WHAT WENT WRONG ===
Common reasons applications are rejected:
- Incomplete documentation
- Missing required medical/legal documents
- Eligibility criteria not met
- Capacity constraints
- Application submitted after deadline
- Conflicting information provided

Your specific reason is detailed above in the "Reason for Rejection" section.

=== NEED HELP? ===
We understand this may be disappointing news. Our Housing Assistance team is here to help you explore your options and answer any questions.

Contact Options:
- Email: housing@university.edu
- Phone: (555) 123-4567
- In-Person: Housing Office, Building A, Room 101
- Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
- Schedule Appointment: housing.appointments@university.edu

=== IMPORTANT DEADLINES ===
- Appeal Submission Deadline: $appeal_deadline
- New Application Possible: Yes, at any time
- Housing Payment Deadline: N/A (application not approved)

=== ADDITIONAL NOTES ===
$additional_notes

While we were unable to approve your application at this time, we encourage you to:
1. Review the rejection reason carefully
2. Address any deficiencies mentioned
3. Gather required documentation
4. Contact our office for guidance
5. Consider submitting an appeal or new application

We are committed to helping all students find suitable housing options. Please don't hesitate to reach out to us for assistance.

Best regards,
$reviewed_by
University Housing Administration
Email: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567

This decision was made in accordance with University Housing Policies and Procedures. For more information, visit: housing.university.edu/policies
